shell.intro_para_1: Dear partners, to size equipment that fits your application precisely, please fill in the questionnaire below or send us a technical specification covering the same data.
shell.intro_para_2: If you have any difficulty completing the questionnaire, call +7 (812) 416-45-00 — our engineers will be glad to assist.
shell.disclaimer_body: Profit LLC is not responsible for the accuracy of the input data provided in this questionnaire. If the customer declines to complete the questionnaire, we treat it as acceptance of the technical specification implied by the catalogue code in the order, in line with the ANHEL® catalogue, with no additional requirements.
shell.consent_label: I agree to the processing of personal data under the privacy policy
shell.thanks_body: We have received your request. A manager will get back to you within one business day.
shell.restored: Data from your previous session has been restored. You can continue from where you left off.
shell.error_default: We could not send your request. Please try again later.
shell.error_network: Network error. Please download the PDF version and email it to info@anhelspb.com — we will process your request.

validation.consent_required: Consent to personal data processing is required
